CustomField.description: Filled by the website lead form from the utm_medium URL parameter. Not edited by hand. The lead Flow reads this to choose the campaign: cpc or ppc is Paid Search, paid_social is Paid Social, anything else is Organic and Direct. Mapped to the Opportunity on conversion.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The type of traffic that sent this lead, for example cpc, paid_social or email. Set automatically by the website form.
CustomField.label: UTM Medium
